faq.question: Is my JSON data uploaded to a server?
faq.answer: No. All comparison happens locally in your browser. Your JSON data is not uploaded to a remote server and does not leave your device.

faq.question: What types of differences does it detect?
faq.answer: It detects every difference between two JSON documents: added keys, removed keys, changed values, and type changes. Nested objects and arrays are compared recursively, and all modifications are highlighted.

faq.question: Can I compare JSON files of different sizes?
faq.answer: Yes. The tool handles JSON documents of any size and structure. Differences are shown regardless of the documents' sizes, so you can compare JSON with confidence even when one version is much larger.

faq.question: Does it support nested JSON objects?
faq.answer: Yes. The comparison is recursive and works with deeply nested JSON objects and arrays. You can compare JSON with any level of nesting and see every difference in the structure.

faq.question: Can I copy or export the diff results?
faq.answer: Yes. After comparing, you can copy the diff results to your clipboard or download them as a report file. This makes it easy to share differences with your team or attach them to bug reports.

faq.question: Can I load JSON from a URL?
faq.answer: Yes. Use the ?url= parameter to load JSON from a remote URL. This is useful for comparing API responses, remote configuration files, or any JSON accessible via HTTP.

faq.question: Can I compare large JSON files?
faq.answer: You can compare larger JSON files as long as they can be loaded and processed by your browser. The practical limit depends on available memory, device performance, and the complexity of the JSON structures.

faq.question: What do the colors in the diff mean?
faq.answer: Typically, added keys or values are shown in green, removed items in red, and changed values in yellow or another highlight color. The exact scheme may vary, but the legend or labels indicate which type of change each color represents.

article.title: How to Compare JSON Files Online & Find Differences
article.content:
Why Compare JSON?

Comparing JSON documents is essential for debugging APIs, verifying configuration changes, and ensuring data integrity. Whether you're checking API responses, comparing config files, or validating data migrations, a JSON diff tool helps you spot every difference quickly and accurately.

Common Use Cases

  • API debugging: Compare expected vs actual API responses to find bugs and mismatches
  • Configuration changes: Track changes between config file versions or environment-specific settings
  • Data migration: Verify that data was transferred correctly between systems or databases
  • Code review: Compare JSON payloads in pull requests or deployment diffs
  • Testing: Compare test fixtures or snapshot outputs to detect regressions

How to Compare JSON Online

  1. Paste JSON A: Add your original JSON document to the left panel.
  2. Paste JSON B: Add your modified JSON document to the right panel.
  3. Click Compare: Run the comparison to analyze both documents.
  4. Review results: Added, removed, and changed keys and values are highlighted with color-coded indicators.
  5. Export if needed: Copy the diff results or download them as a report for documentation or team sharing.

Understanding Diff Results

  • Added (Green): Keys or values that exist in JSON B but not in JSON A
  • Removed (Red): Keys or values present in JSON A but missing in JSON B
  • Changed (Yellow/Highlight): Keys that exist in both documents but have different values or types

Nested objects and arrays are compared recursively, so differences deep inside the structure are also detected and highlighted.

Best Practices

  • Format first: Use a JSON formatter to ensure both documents are readable before comparing.
  • Check structure: Make sure both JSONs have a similar overall structure; large structural differences can produce many changes.
  • Export results: Copy or download diff results for bug reports, documentation, or code review comments.
  • Use URL input: When available, compare remote API responses directly via URL instead of copying and pasting.
  • Iterate gradually: For complex changes, compare intermediate versions to understand how the data evolved.

Client-Side Privacy

This JSON compare tool processes input in your browser instead of requiring an upload to a remote service. That can be convenient for development data and private configuration snippets. However, you should still avoid entering passwords, API keys, access tokens, or other highly sensitive information into any browser-based tool.

article.title: 如何在线比较 JSON 文件并查找差异
article.content:
为什么要比较 JSON？

比较 JSON 文档对于调试 API、验证配置更改和确保数据完整性非常重要。无论是在检查 API 响应、比较配置文件版本，还是验证数据迁移结果，JSON 差异工具都能帮助你快速、准确地发现每个差异。

常见使用场景

  • API 调试：比较预期与实际 API 响应，查找字段缺失、值错误或结构变化等问题
  • 配置更改：跟踪不同版本配置文件之间的差异，或对比不同环境的配置
  • 数据迁移：验证数据是否在系统或数据库之间正确传输，没有遗漏或错误
  • 代码审查：在 Pull Request 中比较 JSON 负载，确认改动是否符合预期
  • 测试与回归：比较测试用例的 JSON 输出或快照，检测回归和意外变更

如何在线比较 JSON

  1. 粘贴 JSON A：将原始 JSON 文档添加到左侧面板。
  2. 粘贴 JSON B：将修改后的 JSON 文档添加到右侧面板。
  3. 点击比较：运行比较，分析两个文档的差异。
  4. 查看结果：新增、删除和修改的键与值会以颜色标记，方便快速识别。
  5. 导出结果（可选）：复制差异内容或下载为报告，用于问题记录、文档或团队沟通。

理解差异结果

  • 新增（绿色）：在 JSON B 中存在但在 JSON A 中不存在的键或值
  • 删除（红色）：在 JSON A 中存在但在 JSON B 中缺失的键或值
  • 修改（黄色/高亮）：在两个文档中都存在，但值或类型发生变化的键

嵌套对象和数组会递归比较，因此深层结构中的差异也会被检测并高亮显示。

最佳实践

  • 先格式化：使用 JSON 格式化工具确保两个文档可读，再进行比较。
  • 检查整体结构：如果两个 JSON 的整体结构差异很大，可能会产生大量变更提示，此时可以分步比较中间版本。
  • 导出结果：将差异结果复制到剪贴板或下载为报告，便于在问题报告、文档或代码审查中使用。
  • 利用 URL 输入：在支持时，直接通过 URL 比较远程 API 响应，减少复制粘贴的步骤。
  • 逐步对比：对于复杂变更，可以比较多个中间版本，理解数据是如何逐步演化的。

浏览器本地处理与隐私

这个 JSON 比较工具在浏览器中处理输入内容，不要求将数据上传到远程服务。对于开发数据和私密配置片段来说，本地处理更加方便。不过，仍然不建议在任何浏览器工具中输入密码、API 密钥、访问令牌或其他高度敏感的信息。
